Class FloridianToothRecords

java.lang.Object
FloridianToothRecords
public class FloridianToothRecords extends Object
Floridian Tooth Records: records the teeth of the members of one Florida family and offers a menu to print the record, extract a tooth and report the family's root canal indices. The names are kept in an array of strings and the teeth in a three dimensional array of characters (one plane per person, one row per layer, one column per tooth).
Author:
Maxime Manuel Afonso
